recipe.name: restart_orchestrator

steps.action: Inspect the target port and confirm its owner.
Use the dedicated orchestrator restart after explicit restart authorization.
Reinspect after the scan-cache TTL; verify a new owner PID and application readiness. For orchestrator also verify a new /health generation.

recipe.execution_note: This hint executes nothing. Stop/restart needs explicit authorization for the identified target; never infer a PID or launch command.

suggestion.reason: Recycling requires inspection, replacement and verification, not just termination.
